text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can produce art, music, and writing that look or sound surprisingly human. Some programs create paintings, compose songs, or even write short stories. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. AI learns from existing data and patterns, while humans bring emotion, personal experience, and imagination to their work. AI can support artists by offering new ideas, but it cannot feel or truly understand what it creates. In the end, AI is a powerful tool, but human creativity remains unique and special.
